source.title: Call for Applicants - WEC Leader (August 2023)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) Leader.**

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms 24 months and to spend at least 6 hours  per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Proactivity
* Clear background
* Trustworthiness
* Independence
* Accountability

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until September 18th, 2023, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WEC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WEC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2022.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.4%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support,

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会负责人招募（2023 年 8 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的**道德委员会（WEC）负责人**。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会工作，并具备以下条件：

* 较强的领导能力
* 主动积极
* 背景清白
* 诚实可靠
* 能够独立判断
* 勇于承担责任

申请时间为即日起至 2023 年 9 月 18 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者请将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

* 简短的个人介绍
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
* 担任 WEC 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WEC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2022.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.4%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 [WCA 动议 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节投票选出新负责人，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢各位申请和支持。
